summary: Resets the current animation index dword at this+0x80 (a1[32]) to zero, then chains to the SpriteFrameSelector helper with the same object pointer and returns its result.

operations.description: Zero the 32-bit field at this+0x80 (dword index a1[32], the current animation position).
Chain to the SpriteFrameSelector helper with the same object pointer to select the initial frame.
Return the value produced by the SpriteFrameSelector call.

unresolved: SpriteFrameSelector has no packet callee address, so its identity and the meaning of its return value are unverified.
The receiver object type is unconfirmed; the field at 0x80 is only known to be zeroed by this routine.
Why the animation index reset is split from the frame-selection step is unknown.
